name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Development Manager | Relationship Cultivation, CRM Operations & Mission-Driven Communications
summary: Relationship-driven operator with 15+ years cultivating and stewarding a portfolio of accounts and partners, tracking performance in Salesforce, and translating outcomes into clear reporting for leadership. Directly supervised and developed teams of 8 to 20 people and writes content that turns operational work into a story a non-technical audience can act on. Brings a genuine, personal commitment to immigrant and refugee communities to Rocky Mountain Welcome Center's mission, alongside the operational discipline to build a development function that runs consistently.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary relationship for a portfolio of clients, running discovery to align delivery with each client's goals and communicating outcomes clearly to stakeholders.
Write and publish thought leadership content and newsletters, translating operational work into a narrative a non-technical audience can act on.

Track engagement and performance data across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, building reporting that surfaces at-risk relationships early, and coordinate with outside vendors and specialists as needed to deliver client outcomes.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded, cultivated, and stewarded a portfolio of 15-20 reseller partners, retaining all but one (~94% retention) through proactive relationship management.
Tracked partner performance and health data in Salesforce, analyzing utilization to identify at-risk relationships and recommend interventions.

bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, cultivating and stewarding relationships that contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates.
